**Daily Devotional**

**March 14**

*14 Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men. (Luke 2:14 KJV)*

This verse is one of the most misquoted verses in the Bible. This is where the Angels were announcing the birth of a Savior to the Shepherd’s in the field. Most preachers I have ever heard teach it that the Angels were announcing peace between men on earth, and that is not what they were saying. Jesus did not come to bring peace on earth between mankind; but rather division (Matthew 10:34, Luke 12:51). The Angels were declaring peace between God and man, as the war was now over. God had been at war with man’s sin and Jesus ended that war.

Jesus caused division between families and all the believers and non-believers. But He was the Prince of Peace because He brought all who would believe in Him, into harmony with God again, which is eternal life (John 17:3). Because of the sins in the world, thanks to Satan, God was at war with mankind, and Jesus through His sacrifice was able to atone for the sins of the world (1 John 2:2), and thereby bring us into fellowship with the Father. Not only did He bring peace, but good will toward man from God. We sure do need to Glorify our Lord for such an awesome thing that He has done, to bring us into union with our Father in Heaven. Praise God!
